label: WatchGuard Firebox M390 firewall
description: 1U UTM firewall with eight 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 ports, a single 150 W PSU, 128 GB m.2 storage and 8 GB ECC RAM; the console is an RJ45 RS232 port and the two USB 3.0 ports are not network interfaces. No SFP cages on this model.
notes: WatchGuard M290/390/590/690 hardware guide, interface specification as shipped: M390 = '8 x 1000 Base-TX (10/100/1000Mbps) RJ45 connector', I/O '2 x USB 3.0, 1 x RJ45 RS232 console'. This is the model where the family splits: the M290 is identical on ports (8x1G, single 65 W PSU, 4 GB RAM) while the M590 adds 2x 10G SFP+ and the M690 adds 2x 10G SFP+ plus 2x 10/2.5/10G RJ45. NXP LS2084A, 128 GB m.2, 8 GB ECC, single 150 W PSU, 3.65 kg. Ports are labelled 0-7 in Fireware, so they are modelled as eth0-eth7; the console is not a network port and is deliberately absent.
